page.description: ChimeraOS editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A Steam Big Picture-based couch-gaming OS that turns a PC or handheld into a console-like Steam machine. Arch-based with a read-only btrfs root, A/B frzr updates, and one installer ISO for every supported device.
pros: Single x86_64 installer works on all 27+ supported devices
A/B read-only root with frzr snapshot updates
Controller-first Steam Big Picture session out of the box
Proton, GE Proton, and gamescope built in
cons: UEFI only — no legacy BIOS support
pacman is disabled by default; changes are overwritten on update
NVIDIA support requires GTX 16 series or newer
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for ChimeraOS; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write the installer ISO to a USB stick with Etcher, boot UEFI, and follow the installer. After first boot the system updates itself via frzr A/B btrfs snapshots. The target disk is owned by ChimeraOS; dual booting is not supported.

editions.name: Desktop (Gaming)
editions.description: Steam Big Picture gaming session with gamescope, Proton, and a read-only btrfs root. One ISO works on all 27+ supported devices including handhelds, mini PCs, and desktops.
editions.usbNote: 915 MB ISO. Write with Etcher or dd; writing erases the USB stick. UEFI boot only.
